name: Tilt-shift miniature
description: Edits the photo to restyle it as a tilt-shift miniature model with shallow focus and saturated colors.
aliases: restyle it as a tilt-shift miniature model with shallow focus and saturated colors

prompt.default: Edit the image to restyle it as a tilt-shift miniature model with shallow focus and saturated colors. Keep the composition and subject identical.
prompt.local-wan: The scene becomes a detailed tabletop miniature with tiny crafted objects and saturated colors. A narrow band through the subject is sharp while the foreground and distant background soften strongly.
